events.what_it_is: A free three-day immersive TEMPTATIONS pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with interactive/photo moments, free cat treats and chances to win exclusive merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Free admission, TEMPTATIONS cat treats to take home, and chances to win exclusive merchandise.
events.caveats: Official TEMPTATIONS and Mars sources describe the physical NYC pop-up as free and do not state that an RSVP or ticket is required. Treats and merchandise/prizes may be limited by availability.
events.practical_notes: Open September 17–19, noon–6 PM each day at 213 Bowery. Current official source language supports walk-in public access; no registration requirement is published.

events.event_name: CookUnity: The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas where eight chefs serve complimentary CookUnity dishes from neighborhood counters.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made CookUnity meals and hot bites while supplies last, plus a bodega-style scratch-off with chances to win additional CookUnity meals and dining experiences.
events.caveats: Multiple current sources agree the event is open to the public with no advance RSVP stated. Food is explicitly while supplies last, so availability can end before the advertised 2:30 PM finish.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM at five Manhattan bodegas: Chelsea, Flatiron, Midtown, Murray Hill and West Village. Walk-in; arrive early because complimentary meals are supply-limited.
